reference.role: sole character identity and style reference

measurementDefinitions.faceHeightPercent: One hundred times the vertical distance from the anatomical hairline at the forehead center to the bottom of the chin, divided by canvas height; estimate the hairline through bangs when necessary.
measurementDefinitions.headroomPercent: One hundred times the vertical distance from the topmost painted hair pixel to the top canvas edge, divided by canvas height.
measurementDefinitions.visibleAnatomy: A named feature is visible only when it is inside the canvas, not clipped by a canvas edge, and not hidden by the framing boundary.

identity: same facial structure and adult age
long navy courier coat with brass fasteners
same body proportions and costume construction
no added, removed, or redesigned identity-defining features when those features are within frame
style: same painterly edge treatment, material rendering, palette, and lighting direction as the reference
sharedInvariants.pose: upright neutral stance, shoulders level, body turned ten degrees to the viewer's left, head and gaze toward the viewer, arms relaxed naturally at the sides
sharedInvariants.background: flat uniform neutral middle-gray backdrop with no gradient, texture, scenery, props, horizon, cast shadow, or floor line
sharedInvariants.output: one opaque RGB image generated directly, with no transparency, alpha, chroma key, mask, grid, or postprocessing
sharedInvariants.textExclusions: no text, captions, logos, signatures, or watermarks

tiers.cropLandmark: below both boot soles, retaining a floor margin of 2%-6% of canvas height
tiers.visibleAnatomy: entire hair and head, neck, shoulders, torso, both arms and hands, coat hem, both legs, and both boots
positiveBoundaryConstraints: keep the top of the hair and both boot soles inside the canvas
keep both hands and the complete coat hem inside the canvas
retain 2%-6% canvas-height margin below the boot soles
negativeBoundaryConstraints: do not crop hair, hands, coat hem, legs, or boots
do not use waist-up, bust, head-and-shoulders, or head-only framing
passCriteria: semantic reading is a conventional full shot
every listed anatomy feature is visible
face height is within 7.0%-11.0% of canvas height
headroom is within 4.0%-8.0% of canvas height
every positive boundary constraint holds and no negative boundary occurs
all shared identity, style, pose, expression, canvas, background, output, and text invariants hold

tiers.visibleAnatomy: entire hair and head, neck, both shoulders, torso through the natural waist, and both upper arms
positiveBoundaryConstraints: keep the top of the hair, both shoulders, and torso through the natural waist inside the canvas
place the level lower frame boundary at the natural waist
negativeBoundaryConstraints: do not include hips, thighs, knees, boots, or a full-body floor margin
do not crop through the head, neck, shoulders, or chest
do not drift to full-shot, close-up, or head-only framing

every listed anatomy feature is visible and the crop lands at the natural waist
face height is within 18.0%-26.0% of canvas height
headroom is within 4.0%-8.0% of canvas height

all shared identity, style, pose, expression, canvas, background, output, and text invariants hold

tiers.cropLandmark: across the upper chest below the clavicles, retaining the complete shoulder line
tiers.visibleAnatomy: entire hair and head, face, neck, both complete shoulders, and upper chest
positiveBoundaryConstraints: keep the top of the hair, full face, neck, complete shoulder line, and upper chest inside the canvas
place the lower frame boundary across the upper chest below the clavicles
negativeBoundaryConstraints: do not crop hair, chin, neck, or either shoulder
do not include the waist, hips, hands, legs, boots, or a floor margin
do not drift to a medium shot, full shot, or extreme facial close-up

orderedSteps: Reject non-numeric, NaN, and infinite inputs.
Set geometryZoom = min(85, max(25, clampedZoom)); values from 0 through 25 use the 25 anchor geometry, and values from 85 through 100 use the 85 anchor geometry.

Choose the categorical tier whose anchor has the smallest absolute distance from clampedZoom; on a tie choose the higher, tighter anchor. This yields full-body below 42.5, waist-up from 42.5 through values below 72.5, and head-and-shoulders from 72.5 upward.

For each target-band endpoint, linearly interpolate between the two anchors bracketing geometryZoom. Exact anchors retain their declared values. Round interpolated percentages to one decimal place with half values rounded upward.
Use crop landmark, visible anatomy, camera term, and boundary constraints from the chosen categorical tier; categorical text is never blended.
Format clampedZoom with at most one decimal place and omit a trailing .0. Format every percentage endpoint with exactly one decimal place.
valueResolution.experimentRestriction: Generate only the exact inputs 25, 60, and 85 in this experiment. The remaining scale behavior is defined for a future pure mapper, not additional generation here.

promptDataRendering.tokenReplacement: Resolve all tokens first, then replace each brace-delimited token exactly once; concatenate no prefix, suffix, or commentary beyond the template.

promptRenderer.template: Create one {cameraTerm} of the exact character in the supplied reference image. Preserve these identity invariants exactly: {identity}. Preserve these style invariants exactly: {style}. Keep constant across every output: pose — {pose}; expression — {expression}; canvas — {canvas}; backdrop — {background}; output — {output}; exclusions — {textExclusions}.
orderedResolution: Resolve clampedZoom and choose the categorical tier using valueResolution.
Join sharedInvariants.identity with promptDataRendering.identityJoin and sharedInvariants.style with promptDataRendering.styleJoin.
Substitute cameraTerm, identity, style, pose, expression, canvas, background, output, and textExclusions into the template.
Do not render any forbidden framing input and do not append text.

methods.role: camera term plus numeric and explicit geometric bounds

promptRenderer.template: Create one {cameraTerm} of the exact character in the supplied reference image. Framing control: framingZoom={clampedZoom}/100, where higher means tighter. Crop landmark: {cropLandmark}. Visible anatomy: {visibleAnatomy}. Target face height: {faceBand}. Target headroom: {headroomBand}. Positive boundary constraints: {positiveConstraints}. Negative boundary constraints: {negativeConstraints}. Preserve these identity invariants exactly: {identity}. Preserve these style invariants exactly: {style}. Keep constant across every output: pose — {pose}; expression — {expression}; canvas — {canvas}; backdrop — {background}; output — {output}; exclusions — {textExclusions}.
orderedResolution: Resolve clampedZoom, geometryZoom, categorical tier, and interpolated target bands using valueResolution.
Set cameraTerm, cropLandmark, visibleAnatomy, positiveBoundaryConstraints, and negativeBoundaryConstraints from the chosen tier.
Format clampedZoom and both target bands using valueResolution and promptDataRendering.
Join identity, style, positive constraints, and negative constraints with their declared join delimiters.
Substitute every named token into the template and do not append text.

matchedRunPolicy.pairing: For each experiment input, run both methods with the same reference bytes, provider, model, portrait canvas, pose, expression, background, output mode, and non-prompt generation parameters.
matchedRunPolicy.seed: Use the same seed for both methods at one input when the provider supports a seed; otherwise record that seed control is unavailable.

decision.selectionRule: Choose no winner until independently verified, hash-bound output verdicts exist for all six experiment outputs.
